symbolDescription: Machine-readable category of a PdfViewerError, for handling failures such as a missing password or an HTTP error in code.

optionDescriptions.PDFJS_LOAD_FAILED: The pdfjs-dist module or its worker failed to load.
optionDescriptions.HTTP_ERROR: The server answered with a non-2xx status (status is set).
optionDescriptions.INVALID_PDF: The bytes are not a valid PDF.
optionDescriptions.PASSWORD_REQUIRED: The document is encrypted and no password was supplied.
